rules.phase: 6.3, pre-registered and committed before the full run
rules.baseline: BF16 cached, score batch 8 (5.2 p5_b8 file). keep_all (uniform at retention 1.0 through the pruning path) must match it exactly (max diff 0) or the run aborts
rules.arms: {uniform, boundary, attn_a, attn_b, random} x {0.25, 0.5, 0.75}; attn_h2o x 3 is diagnostic (reported, never selected)
rules.importance: 6.2 artifacts: eager attention, mean over 16 query heads and 28 layers, doc rows only, raw probabilities; (a) sum_{j>i} A(j,i)/(T-i-1); (b) same weighted by absolute position + 1; h2o = (a) * (T-i-1) (plain column sum); ties -> lower index
rules.retention: doc tokens only (shared prefix never pruned, not counted); kept = min(T, max(half-up(r*T), mandatory)); mandatory = first 1 + last 8 doc tokens; report target, actual, forced fraction, mandatory fraction
rules.verdict: vs p5_b8: no_measurable_loss if 95% CI of delta nDCG@10 inside [-m_ds, +m_ds] (5.2 margins); within_1_point if point delta >= -0.01; else loss
rules.attn_vs_random: paired delta nDCG@10 (attn - random) at equal retention; beats_random iff 95% CI lower bound > 0 on both datasets
rules.b_vs_a: paired delta nDCG@10 (attn_b - attn_a) at equal retention; helps iff CI lower > 0 on both datasets, hurts iff CI upper < 0 on both, else no_clear_difference
rules.phase7_selection: methods uniform, boundary, attn_a, attn_b; lowest retention at which some method's verdict is not loss on both datasets; ties -> larger mean delta nDCG@10 over datasets; if every 0.75 arm is a loss, pick the best 0.75 arm by mean delta and flag all_loss
rules.bootstrap: paired.compare: percentile bootstrap, 10k paired query resamples, seed = cfg.seed
rules.storage: theory BF16 bytes of kept doc tokens here; packed bytes in 6.5
